title: Immersive Inventory
description: Enhance your inventory experience with smooth and intuitive item transfers.
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/lTc3bSFc/images/27eb8e9732508cd4d9c771f21781cc8b30a55c61.png)

**Immersive Inventory is a lightweight and highly convenient quality-of-life mod designed to make inventory management faster, smoother, and more comfortable.**

By simply holding Shift, you can quickly and efficiently move large amounts of items between containers and your inventory without repetitive clicking or dragging. The system is designed to feel natural and responsive, reducing friction during looting, crafting, and sorting.

![Chest](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/lTc3bSFc/images/9aa98bb110e321564a35792652c0630855e1e243.gif)

The mod also features a clean and polished UI, making item transfers visually pleasing while keeping everything simple and intuitive. Every interaction is built to stay out of your way while improving speed and usability.

Perfect for players who handle large inventories and want a faster, more seamless way to organize their items without changing the core Minecraft experience.

**Lightweight. Fast. Comfortable.**
